decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed developments would not be harmful to neighbours living conditions or the appearance of the site.  They would be in compliance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations, and Residential Extension Guidelines of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the visual amenity of the area.)

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until details samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the out building hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
REASON: In order that the Council may be satisfied as to the details of the development in the interests of the visual amenity of the area.

Condition : 6 - The outbuilding shall only be used for storage purposes ancillary to the ground floor retail (A1) unit at the front of the application site, and shall not be used as separate living accommodation, industrial, or business use.

REASON:  To protect neighbouring residents' living conditions and the character of the area.
description: Erection of extension to rear roof slope to first floor flat, installation of roof light to front roof slope, external alterations to south elevation of building, and erection of detached single storey outbuilding at the back of premises.
